focal_proposition: continued expansion of a contested activity (+1) versus slowdown/restriction (-1)

jurisdictions.name: transnational
jurisdictions.declaration: Declared global-reach attribute: the actor is documented as operating across jurisdictions (e.g. standards bodies, multinationals, global platforms). It is an explicit membership attribute, not a leftover catch-all for missing data.

jurisdictions.name: unspecified/missing
jurisdictions.declaration: Declared missing-jurisdiction attribute: the actor's jurisdiction is unknown in the source mapping. Missing data is an explicit declared label and must not be treated as a shared community.

jurisdiction_share_notes: Shares are synthetic pilot priors over declared labels. The former 0.45 transnational/unspecified catch-all is split into 0.25 declared transnational and 0.20 declared unspecified/missing.

v2_changes: Each role declares an explicit jurisdiction distribution; (role, jurisdiction) pairs are allocated jointly by largest remainders instead of shuffling jurisdictions independently across all agents.

The former 'transnational/unspecified' jurisdiction label is split into 'transnational' (declared global-reach attribute) and 'unspecified/missing' (declared missing-jurisdiction attribute); neither forms a privileged encounter community.
Encounter opportunity uses declared pairwise jurisdiction affinities, and initial W construction applies the same affinity weighting as ongoing encounters.
Persistent structural asymmetry decision recorded explicitly (see persistent_structural_asymmetry).

opportunity.affinity_rule: same named jurisdiction: within_jurisdiction; different named jurisdictions: between_jurisdictions; any pair involving a transnational actor (including transnational-transnational): transnational_affinity_to_any; any pair involving an unspecified/missing actor (including unspecified-unspecified): unspecified_affinity_to_any. Missing or ambiguous jurisdiction therefore confers no within-community bonus; genuinely transnational actors get a moderate open affinity in both directions reflecting global spread rather than co-location.
opportunity.initial_ongoing_consistency: The same pairwise affinity matrix C is used both to weight within-group allocation of initial memory W at t=0 and to weight ongoing encounter target selection. Initial tie formation and later tie formation therefore follow one declared opportunity structure; the previous initial-W/encounter-C mismatch is resolved by construction.

reasoning: The five power attributes (material_power, information_advantage, coordination, risk_exposure, exit_power) are ordinal scenario descriptors with no measured conversion to dynamic parameters and no measurement model is used to calibrate a role-based persistent opportunity or attention component.
Adding a persistent role-based mechanism without such a conversion would import an invented structural law; structural choices should not depend on which variant reverses the majority.

The observed decline of core received-attention share under adaptive memory is a real model outcome to be measured and reported, not a defect to be patched by a persistent clamp; no 70% attention clamp is imposed.

Roles therefore remain contextual in this experiment: they affect tier labeling and the initial probability/affinity structure only. The five power attributes stay contextual_only and must not be interpreted as active mechanisms.
persistent_structural_asymmetry.interpretation_rules: W is remembered interaction volume, not money; quenched trait g is susceptibility, not power; plot size encodes received attention, not supplier leverage; no core attention clamp to 70%.
persistent_structural_asymmetry.uncontrolled_dynamics_check: tests/unit/test_f2_scenario_structure.py runs a small-N uncontrolled rollout and records the core received-attention-share trajectory as a smoke/diagnostic; it asserts only that the dynamics run and stay bounded, not that any share is maintained.
